title: A1 Swaara v1.0.4 - Ultra-Fast Music Startup & Instant Playback
changelog:
- Ultra-fast music startup latency decreased from 3-6s down to under 400ms
- 0ms instantaneous gapless playback for next queued and pre-buffered tracks
- Upgraded HTTP transport to HTTP/2 with persistent OkHttp connection pooling
- Enabled high-speed on-the-fly progressive disk caching and 50-track in-memory stream URL cache
- Fixed update comparison logic to prevent redundant update prompts
